sources.entry: Zero-K - Open Source on Springrts engine. Zero-K is a traditional real time strategy game with a focus on player creativity through terrain manipulation, physics, and a large roster of unique units - all while being balanced to support competitive play. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 Lua

summary.one_liner: Zero-K is an open-source real-time strategy game module for the Spring Engine, featuring physics-based projectiles, terrain manipulation, and a large roster of units.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds only the game module files (Spring Engine content) for Zero-K, a traditional RTS. The README describes it as an RTS with physical projectiles, smart units, and a powerful UI, running on the Spring Engine. It emphasizes player creativity through terrain manipulation and physics, along with a large roster of unique units. The game is described as balanced to support competitive play. The README states that infrastructure code, tools, and artwork sources are kept in other repositories. To actually play, the README directs users to download the lobby, and it links to a guide on importing content into the engine.
use_cases: experimenting with terrain manipulation and physics in strategy games
playing multiplayer RTS over a lobby
browsing open-source Spring Engine game content
how_to_run: Download the lobby (link in README) to play the game
Import the module content into the Spring Engine (see importing guide linked in README)
notable: Terrain manipulation as a core mechanic
Repository contains only the game module, not tools or artwork sources
caveats: Requires the Spring Engine and lobby client to play; repository alone is only the game module files
README does not describe platform support or system requirements
